profileLabel: Slight center-left economics (low confidence); mildly power-concentrating on elections (low confidence)
summary: Manila 2nd District representative with 80 principal-authored bills. Authored VAT exemption on electricity with a higher income threshold, estate tax amnesty extension, travel-tax abolition, NIRC amendments, survivorship benefits for NLRC labor arbiters, toll suspension during oil surges, a premature-campaigning definition, a postponement of barangay and SK elections and Dangerous Drugs Act amendments.
caveat: The Dangerous Drugs Act amendment (HB08274) content was not reviewed and could affect civil liberties. The election postponement is a filing, not a vote.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored VAT exemption on electricity with a higher income threshold (-1) and survivorship-benefit parity for NLRC arbiters (-1); estate tax amnesty and travel-tax abolition are neutral. Two issues.
